verdict.rationale: Unleash has a public pricing page that lists which features come with its plans: export/import, custom activation strategies, SSO with SAML/OIDC, and a stale-flag dashboard. The GitHub README also describes a hosted tier that adds RBAC, change requests, SSO and SCIM. None of the cited content shows actual prices or the units that drive cost (seats, MAUs, events or requests), so a product manager could not estimate spend from this evidence. Missing for 10: published price points per plan, explicit cost drivers or billing units, any usage-based pricing explanation, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
